title: PGA Tour Golf III
description: Play tour golf at the TPC at Sawgrass, the TPC at Summerlin and River Highlands, as one of the licensed professionals or against a full field of them, with digitized players and video flyovers of every course.

title: U-Jin Special Collection
description: A re-release that gathers all three volumes of Kounai Shasei, the adult games based on U-Jin's manga, in one package.

title: Tetsu Juuji Shou
description: A scenario disk for Koutetsu no Kishi with twenty new maps, half based on historical battles and half on what-if situations. It was sold through the Takeru software vending machines.
Recruit a team of female wrestlers and enter them in a championship. Each bout is a turn-based exchange of special moves, and guessing the opponent's next move decides who comes out on top.

title: Hanafuda-kyou
description: Hanafuda against the computer under three traditional rule sets, including Koi-Koi and Oicho-Kabu. An open mode shows the opponent's hand for practice.

title: SimCity Terrain Editor
description: An add-on for SimCity that reshapes the land under a city: draw rivers, lakes, islands and forests, or clear a map of everything built on it. A set of ready-made cities is included.
A mother fox sets out across Romulus Forest to find the shrine whose fried tofu can cure her sick child. An illustrated text adventure played by typing commands in katakana.
Command a moon base against an unknown enemy in this turn-based strategy game, and hold it for forty turns to win.
After dreaming of a war between gods, the young swordsman Tile is sent by the king to defeat the goddess Martia and the monsters she set loose on the world. A Japanese-style role-playing game.
Work as a hospital doctor: examine patients, order X-rays and ultrasound scans, decide on treatment, and operate when surgery is needed.
Mahjong against three women from the arcade series, where winning rounds unlocks undressing scenes. This computer version adds a mode in which the opponents play each other.
The young warrior Ares looks into disappearances from a nearby town and finds an evil power waiting in the caves. A classic Japanese role-playing game with first-person battles.
Ares and his companions crash their airship on an unknown continent and help its king fight off the monsters attacking his land.
The final part of the Agalta trilogy, in which the heroes enter the World of Spirits to end the thousand-year struggle against the Demon King Zozem.
A vertically scrolling shooter played as one continuous flight through space. The ship can take several hits, and its screen-clearing attack costs one of them.
Strip mahjong against five increasingly skilled opponents in a tournament, with betting rules and handicaps chosen before each game.
A follow-up to Zettai Mahjong with three opponents borrowed from popular fighting games. Unlike the first game, it stops short of explicit nudity.
On her sixteenth birthday, Princess Gery must clear every puzzle room in a tower to prove herself. Steer lettered balls into a hole across 24 rooms.

title: Reines du Sabbat
description: Puff heads into the forest of Pia to find the Snow Herb, the one cure for her brother's mysterious fever. A Japanese-style role-playing game.

description: Aleph, son of a fallen warrior, starts out clearing goblins near his village and ends up on a quest to restore the balance between the world's races. A traditional party-based role-playing game.
An adult visual novel about winning over Arisa, in which any wrong choice ends the game on the spot.
Now dating Arisa, the hero finds himself drawn to Yui. Choose carefully or end up with neither.
An adult collection of two card games, Super Lady Shaken and Gin Rummy, with a mode for the music and the developers' notes.
A doujin vertical shooter set in a near-future war between Japan and a restored Soviet Union, starting with the defense of Hokkaido.
